# v2026.10.33

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.33.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/flow/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.33.md).

This release covers **13 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Flow reads each older job from the work system, and the accounting system's latest changes, just before it drafts or sends an invoice. ([#154](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/154), [#157](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/157))
- A job that changes after its invoice is compared three ways, and a status that moves back holds the job for a person. ([#151](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/151))
- A daily reconcile shows each day where jobs, obligations and invoices do not agree. ([#149](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/149))
- A slow Seazona sweep finds missed edits and deletes on old orders, and invoices and clients that are gone. ([#152](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/152))
- A Preview button opens any invoice as a PDF. ([#148](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/148))
- After Send, the next invoice opens and the count holds; a sent invoice shows Sent to Xero. ([#158](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/158))

## Changes

- A job that changes after its invoice is compared three ways; a status that moves back holds the job. ([#151](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/151))
- A daily reconcile shows each day where jobs, obligations and invoices do not agree. ([#149](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/149))
- Read each old job from the work system just before Flow drafts or sends it. ([#154](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/154))
- A Preview button opens the invoice as a PDF. ([#148](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/148))
- A slow Seazona sweep finds missed edits and deletes on old orders, and gone invoices and clients. ([#152](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/152))
- Read the accounting system's latest changes before drafting and sending. ([#157](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/157))
- After Send the next invoice opens and the count holds; a sent invoice shows Sent to Xero. ([#158](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/158))
- A changelog file for each release, copied from OpenClaw, and release notes taken from it. ([#153](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/153))

## Fixes

- Invoice tabs switch at once. ([#123](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/123))
- Seazona health says when the poll is stale, stuck or stopped, and which calls failed. ([#146](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/146))
- A quarantined Seazona invoice or client is read again when its wait ends. ([#147](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/flow/pull/147))
